 7 more die of dengue, record 2,249 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 384 this year 
 Published : 25 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 25 October 2026, 17:14
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least seven dengue patients died and 2,249 others were hospitalised in the 24 hours until 8:00am today, marking the highest single-day hospitalisation figure, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the seven deaths, two each were reported in Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) and Mymensingh Division, while one each occurred in Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC), Khulna Division and Rajshahi Division, the DGHS said.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities and infections, the total number of dengue-related deaths this year has risen to 384, while the number of reported cases has reached 123,948.
 Currently, 6,164 dengue patients are receiving treatment at hospitals across the country.
